# Codestral

Our cutting-edge language model for code completion released end of July 2025, Codestral specializes in low-latency, high-frequency tasks such as fill-in-the-middle (FIM) and code generation.

- API names: `codestral-2508`, `codestral-latest`
- Status: GA
- Type: Premier, Specialist
- Release date: 2025-07-30
- Version: 25.08
- Context length: 128k
- Input: text
- Output: text
- Features: structured-outputs, function-calling, predicted-outputs, document-qna, prefix, batching, chat-completions, fim
- Speed rating: 3/5
- Performance rating: 4/5
- Pricing: Input $0.3 /M Tokens; Output $0.9 /M Tokens
